footerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for PlayStation 4/5 consoles (PlayActor + external title endpoint). Compatible with Homebridge v1.8 and v2.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown for this platform in the Homebridge logs.

endpoint.title: Title endpoint URL
endpoint.description: URL of your external status endpoint. It must answer with JSON containing a "title" field.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (ms)
pollInterval.description: How often the title endpoint and the console state are refreshed, in milliseconds.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language used for titles and log messages.
